claims.text: Incident-response support is mechanized: security-significant platform events (authentication-failure bursts, break-glass use, revocation storms, audit-verification failures) are first-class signed egress events over the webhook channel, and unimplemented 800-171 requirements live in an append-only POA&M register (items, milestones, status as events) seeded with the §3.13.11 FIPS gap.
boundary: Scope: IR family support only — the incident-response capability and its testing remain the organization's (matrix 3.6)
Webhook channel is E4 (CLM-005-21); the IR event classes and the POA&M register are E6 (T553/T554) — the claim joins both and is discharged across them

evidence.ref: Spec 005 §13 (CMMC amendment, claims-first, 2026-10-12) §13.7 (POA&M register; incident-response hooks)

boundary: Scope: the Axiovex-hosted shape only; the self-hosted shape (T546) is the fully capable CUI path in the meantime
